covers: JSE session to 09:49 SAST on 20 Nov 2026, with Thursday's US close for reference
headline: JSE extends the sell-off: All Share 104,265 (-1.8%), Top 40 96,398 (-2.0%); gold miners down 4–6% while the rand firms to R17.49/$
summary: The JSE All Share was at 104,265.03 and the Top 40 at 96,398.30 shortly before 10:00 SAST on 20 Nov 2026, 1.8% and 2.0% below Thursday's closes of 106,216.49 and 98,385.12 (LRC Market Dashboard, Yahoo Finance). Wall Street's last close was the S&P 500 at 7,175.83 and the Nasdaq at 23,879.20 on 19 Nov, and that tech-led weakness is feeding into Johannesburg, with miners leading the losses. Gold steadied at $3,573.40 (about 1.3% above Thursday's $3,526.30 close) and the rand firmed to R17.49 per dollar from R17.54 earlier this morning, but both remain sharply weaker on the week.

items.title: All Share 104,265.03 (-1.8%), Top 40 96,398.30 (-2.0%) in early trade
items.summary: Both indices fell further on Friday morning (20 Nov 2026, quotes to about 09:49 SAST) after Thursday's -5.5% and -5.8% weekly declines. The All Share is now 7.2% below its 13 Nov level of 112,387.90 (LRC Market Dashboard, Yahoo Finance).

items.title: Miners lead the fall: Sibanye-Stillwater -5.8%, Impala -5.6%, AngloGold -5.1%, Harmony -4.4%, Gold Fields -4.4%
items.summary: Precious-metal miners gave back gains despite steadier metal prices this morning; Anglo American was 3.3% lower at R748.58 and BHP 2.9% lower at R593.33 (LRC Stock Scanner quotes, 20 Nov 2026 ~09:49 SAST). Impala had gained 5.2% on Thursday.

items.title: Banks lower; Mr Price +3.1% and BAT +0.8% buck the trend
items.summary: Standard Bank -1.4% to R280.37, FirstRand -1.3% to R87.23 and Absa -1.6% to R205.59, while Mr Price rose 3.1% to R183.50; Naspers (-0.4%) and Prosus (-0.7%) held up better than the index (LRC Stock Scanner quotes, 20 Nov 2026 ~09:49 SAST).

items.title: Last close: S&P 500 7,175.83, Nasdaq 23,879.20 (19 Nov)
items.summary: Wall Street is closed until 16:30 SAST. Thursday's close left the S&P 500 5.1% lower on the week and the Nasdaq 5.0% lower; the US 10-year yield closed at 5.05% (LRC Market Dashboard, Yahoo Finance, 19 Nov 2026).

items.title: Rand firms to R17.49/$ but is 4.4% weaker on the week
items.summary: USD/ZAR at 17.4919 on the morning of 20 Nov 2026 vs 16.7584 on 13 Nov; the euro is at R19.20 and the pound at R22.93 (LRC Market Dashboard, Yahoo Finance).

items.title: Gold steadies at $3,573.40; platinum $1,308.70; Brent $89.57; copper $12,243/t
items.summary: Gold futures are about 1.3% above Thursday's close of $3,526.30 but still 8.1% below the 13 Nov level of $3,886.30; platinum is 12.1% lower on the week and Brent 6.5% lower (LRC Market Dashboard, Yahoo Finance, 20 Nov 2026 morning).

items.title: MTN -1.1% to R222.08, Telkom +0.3% to R67.24
items.summary: Both are moving less than the Top 40 this morning (LRC Stock Scanner quotes, 20 Nov 2026 ~09:49 SAST). No company news; ratings unchanged.

items.title: US names unchanged since Thursday's close: Nvidia $145.98, Meta $596.22, Intuit $310.02, Deckers $78.95
items.summary: No new US trading until 16:30 SAST; Thursday's moves were Nvidia -3.3%, Meta -3.3%, Intuit -1.0% and Deckers -5.6% (LRC Stock Scanner, 19 Nov 2026 close). Ratings unchanged.
